crossRefs.note: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

translations.web: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
translations.bsb: The righteous see it and are glad; the innocent mock them:
translations.kjv: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
translations.asv: The righteous see it, and are glad; And the innocent laugh them to scorn,
